> import numpy as np
> import json
> import scipy.optimize as opt
>
> def model(x, *params):
>     x0, gamma, amp, offset = params
>     return amp / ((x - x0) ** 2 + gamma ** 2) + offset
>
> # Read data
> x_vals = []
> y_vals = []
> with open('graphene.dat', 'r') as f:
>     for line in f:
>         line = line.strip()
>         if not line:
>             continue
>         tokens = line.split()
>         if len(tokens) != 2:
>             continue
>         x_part = tokens[0]
>         y_part = tokens[1]
>         x = x_part.split(',')
>         y = y_part.split(',')
>         if len(x) != 2 or len(y) != 2:
>             continue
>         x_vals.append(int(x[0]))
>         y_vals.append(int(y[1]))
>
> x = np.array(x_vals, dtype=float)
> y = np.array(y_vals, dtype=float)
> print('Parsed x:', x[:5])
> print('Parsed y:', y[:5])
> print('Length:', len(x))
>
> # Fit G peak
> initial_x0_g = 1580
> popt_g, pcov = opt.curve_fit(model, x, y, p0=[initial_x0_g, 10.0, 100.0, 1000.0])
>
> # Fit 2D peak
> initial_x0_2d = 2700

root@d2b3d112be4a:/app# cat > find_peaks.py << 'EOF'
> import numpy as np
> x_vals = []
> y_vals = []
> with open('graphene.dat', 'r') as f:
>     for line in f:
>         line = line.strip()
>         if not line:
>             continue
>         tokens = line.split()
>         if len(tokens) != 2:
>             continue
>         x_part = tokens[0]
>         y_part = tokens[1]
>         x = x_part.split(',')
>         y = y_part.split(',')
>         if len(x) != 2 or len(y) != 2:
>             continue
>         x_vals.append(int(x[0]))
>         y_vals.append(int(y[1]))
>
> x = np.array(x_vals)
> y = np.array(y_vals)
> print('Min x:', x.min(), 'Max x:', x.max())
> print('Min y:', y.min(), 'Max y:', y.max())
> print('Peak indices in x:', np.argmax(x), np.argmin(x))
> print('Peak indices in y:', np.argmax(y), np.argmin(y))
> print('Peak values in x:', x[np.argmax(x)], x[np.argmin(x)])
> print('Peak values in y:', y[np.argmax(y)], y[np.argmin(y)])
> EOF
